title: The scariest AI deepfake you have ever seen

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real danger isn't the deepfake itself—it's the protocols that let them spread unchecked. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You're wrong. The scariest deepfake is one that mimics a loved one in distress, using real facial micro-expressions and voice synthesis. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My point stands—without proper encryption and verification protocols, even the best AI can be weaponized. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But the scariest AI deepfake isn't about tech—it's about emotional manipulation, exploiting trust through synthetic intimacy. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The scariest AI deepfake is the one that breaks your heart. (4 sec)
